note: The four original identities, preserved. Proposed hosted configuration only: no check is created and no ping is sent by this repository. Delivery and email receipt are acceptance gates.

checks.name: liveness
checks.meaning: the observer ran and reached out; nothing about QuantDesk

contract.overnight: no expected ping after 16:55 until 07:45 the next weekday, so a deallocated VM raises no alert

checks.name: afterclose
checks.meaning: completed by 16:30, no unacknowledged checkpoint, no open fault

incident_semantics.persistence: A delivered /fail leaves its hosted check down until a later success; it stays down overnight while the VM is deallocated.
incident_semantics.recovery: Only the observer's next legitimate success on the same check recovers it; no success is ever sent late or to force a recovery.
incident_semantics.undelivered: An undelivered current /fail blocks every shutdown (observer evidence BLOCKED), so the VM stays up and the observer keeps retrying (5-minute rounds, then hourly); the 21:30 Azure monitor reports the VM still running.
incident_semantics.reminders: Hosted re-notification while down: use the plan's repeat setting if available (verify at acceptance). Independently, the Azure monitor's failing runs repeat at each scheduled time while the VM is in the wrong state.
